quote: They told us the truth about a structural wall in the very first meeting, which is why we trusted every decision after it. Nineteen weeks later the house is exactly the drawing we signed off.

quote: One contract, one number to call. Our facilities manager described it as the first fit-out in eleven years she did not have to manage herself.

quote: The rollout manual they wrote paid for the flagship. Our fourth store came in eighteen percent cheaper per square foot using the same fixtures.

quote: Our chef was in the room from week one. The pass works because they designed the dining floor around it instead of around a mood board.

quote: We stayed in the apartment for the whole nine weeks. Two children, one working kitchen, zero shouting. I still do not know how they managed that.

quote: They designed the queue before they designed the ceiling. That is why our morning peak never spills onto the pavement.

quote: Patients stopped asking where the paediatric side is. That single planning decision was worth the whole fee.

quote: Selling silence is our product. They zoned the floor so that promise still holds at four in the afternoon on a Tuesday.
